{{Quote|Clues left by the keepers of this site tell us it is a grave, belonging to some of the first settlers of Tatooine. Small graves surround a center stone which we believe may house the remains of the leader. Much is unknown about this place.. Unfortunately, any evidence left from history, save from the small carvings in the rocks, has been stolen long ago and only tall stones remain as a testament to their glory and achievements.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (1/8)}}</ref>}}
The '''Hero's Grave''' was a graveyard located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The grave was thought to hold the remains of some of the first settlers of Tatooine. The site consisted of several small graves,<ref name="SWG:AEL" /> forming a circle of stones, that surrounded a bigger center stone<ref name="SWG" /> which might house the corpse of the leader.<ref name="SWG:AEL" /> Thousands of years later,<ref name="SoT" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] by the name of [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] traveled to the grave. Unfortunately, he was not able to find any information about the people buried there since the site was plundered long ago.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hero's Grave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Hero's Grave was one of many unmarked points of interests on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (1/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the Hero's Grave.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />
